overall: MARGINAL TO POOR: the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo fish well; the east side is shut by wind all day
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination , led by east wind at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao, Ciron and Barangonan (14–21.6 kt through the next 24h), plus current at Tara and Turda (1.0–1.1 kt about 4–8 PM), Barangonan (1.5 kt about 10 PM–midnight) and Decabaitot (1.2–1.4 kt about 9 PM–1 AM). Rain is minor: 0.2–0.4 mm/h on the Coron side about noon–8 PM.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists an older tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Fishing has turned POOR on 7 of 16 grounds: 5 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (yesterday afternoon 6 / 10 / 0). The east wind no longer ends at noon today. Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao and Ciron stay at 15–20 kt all day and build again to 19–21.6 kt from about 1–5 AM Friday. Tara and Turda dropped to POOR on 0.9 kt current, and Binudac slipped to MARGINAL.

Fri 6 supply stays SLIGHTLY SOFT but now leans softer , since the east side loses all of Thursday. Sun 8 improves from SLIGHTLY SOFT to NEAR NORMAL (Saturday is now 10 kt, gusts 18, 1.1 mm; was 11 kt, 2.4 mm). Tuesday is now the roughest day (12 kt, gusts 18), so Wed 11 is SLIGHTLY SOFT. Friday is still the calmest day (8.0 kt, gusts 13, dry), so Sat 7 stays NORMAL. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Thu–Wed (guide only; it reacts to the 0.6 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is moderate, leaning higher for Friday: three soft arrival days in a row (Wed 4, Thu 5, Fri 6), and the east grounds will have missed about 36 hours by Friday morning. Lean on the Coron side, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for Friday supply.

bestWindow.headline: About 7 PM tonight to 1 AM Friday, Coron side; all day at Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo
details: Coron and Galoc: under 4 kt from about 7 PM to 1 AM, current 0.1–0.4; also fine this morning at 6–8 kt. Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 4.8–7.7 kt with 0.1–0.4 kt current all day. Decabobo: 1.4–7 kt, current 0.2–0.5 (the dashboard's best hour is about 8 AM here). Tara and Turda: wind is light, so go about 9 AM–1 PM when the current eases to 0.5–0.6 kt. East side: no usable window in the next 24h; the lightest spell is about 1–5 PM at 15–16 kt.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan today and tonight (15–21.6 kt).
